title: BIL by Example
lede: Calls to the Blazing Imaging Library for every part of the specification, and the 17 interface gaps they found, each now closed.
footer: BIL by Example, version 8, written against version 69 of the Blazing Imaging Library (BIL) specification, as of 13 October 2026. Code is illustrative and not final.
